character: 70 km, traditional farming village, capital of Reblochon cheese. Quiet and authentic.
name: Le Grand Bornand
description: 90km of pistes, 24 lifts, in the Aravis massif. The village (920m) is traditional Haute-Savoie, while the ski area is at Chinaillon (1,450m) on the Aravis plateau. Known for: cheese-making tradition (Reblochon AOP), the Baroque church, and genuine local farming culture alongside the ski lifts. More authentic and quieter than neighbour La Clusaz.

suitability.families: Very good — traditional village, cheese culture
